mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_HISTORY (userId, mode, chatSeq, input) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mode}, #{chatSeq}, #{input})
INSERT INTO DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_HISTORY (userId, mode, chatSeq, input, output) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mode}, #{chatSeq}, #{input}, #{output})
mapper.select: SELECT IF(COUNT(*), MAX(chatSeq) + 1, 1) AS chatSeq FROM DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_HISTORY WHERE userId = #{userId} AND mode = #{mode}
